scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend && npm run dev:frontend
scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && nohup npm run dev > ../frontend.log 2>&1 &
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && nohup npm run dev > ../backend.log 2>&1 &
scripts.start:frontend: cd frontend && nohup npm run dev > ../frontend.log 2>&1 &
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && nohup npm run dev > ../backend.log 2>&1 &
